extraction.Name: Angeline Larvie Roberts
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes I protested to the Farmer at Little White River station but he said I would have to take it any how.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband, and I farm, raise chickens milk and so forth.
extraction.NOTES: Husband signed receipt for patent on her behalf; sale was for $2600.00 cash, no old debt involved; has eight children depending on her for support; fair health, a little rheumatism; states 'I would have my land yet had the fee patent not been forced upon me'; document notarized by W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, sworn May 14, 1929.
